time.interval: last L complete 1s volume buckets, with L+1 source endpoints
time.available_at: current available_ns after maximum availability of every dependency
time.reset: each full window requires uninterrupted support, same epoch, contiguous seconds; missing OHLC reference masks support
time.contract_boundary: process one selected contract capture independently, never concatenate contracts into one window

bands.sigma_meaning: population price dispersion, not return volatility

proxy.limits: Trades inside a second assigned endpoint midpoint; no reconstruction of trade-price covariance or within-bucket variance. Approximation error not measured against real exact VWAP.

exact.accepted_source: accepted T prints once, including unknown aggressor; never passive F duplicates
exact.alignment: same t_ns / epoch / route as seconds; volume equals corresponding reconstructed counter difference
exact.current_real_dataset: required moments absent; synthetic oracle only
exact.sidecar_next_step: extract aligned moments with source lineage and publication completeness, without rebuilding the entire order book; validate against raw T records before admission

quality.zero_volume: center and weighted geometry unknown; supported return variation remains known
quality.zero_sigma: center and zero width known; z and sigma ratios unknown
quality.zero_rms: variation known zero; normalized-return denominator unknown
quality.unknown_side: retained in total volume with explicit fraction
quality.effective_seconds: (sum bucket_volume)^2 / sum(bucket_volume^2); concentration proxy, not independent trade count

training: causal X only; no labels or policy fitting in this module
